name: external-loadgen-pipeline4-no-strict-nonce

base_results.finding: external loadgen at pipeline depth 1 only drove ~40k RPS; validators were idle

hypothesis: Item 263c proved the external loadgen path is correct but PIPELINE_DEPTH=1 latency-caps delivered RPS at ~40k. Raising PIPELINE_DEPTH to 4 with LOADTEST_STRICT_NONCE_RETRY=0 should increase effective concurrency and drive enough offered load to approach the item251 green reference.

external_loadgen.role: dedicated loadgen runner for all 12 validator ingress endpoints

attempts.264a_setup_failure: PIPELINE_DEPTH=4 with LOADTEST_STRICT_NONCE_RETRY=1 (default). Loadgen rejects --strict-nonce-retry with --pipeline-depth > 1. Fixed by setting LOADTEST_STRICT_NONCE_RETRY=0.
attempts.264b_valid: PIPELINE_DEPTH=4, LOADTEST_STRICT_NONCE_RETRY=0, otherwise same topology and binary as 263c.

commands: LOADTEST_EXTERNAL_RUNNER_SSH=root@203.0.113.10 LOADTEST_WRITERS_JSON=/tmp/and-live-261-rebuilt-v4-default-100k-60s/writers-all.json LOADTEST_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/and-live-264b-external-pipeline4-nostrict-100k-60s LOADTEST_DRAIN_SECS=30 LOADTEST_BATCH_SIZE=8 LOADTEST_PIPELINE_DEPTH=4 LOADTEST_STRICT_NONCE_RETRY=0 LOADTEST_FAIL_ON_ERRORS=1 bash chain/scripts/loadtest_live_network_multi_ingress.sh /tmp/and-live-testnet 32 100000 60
curl kombat_getConsensusMetrics and kombat_getStateRootAtHeight on all four validators

result.classification: Pipeline depth 4 roughly doubles effective external concurrency and materially improves TPS, but measured driver RPS is only 46,906.9 — the external loadgen host still cannot deliver the full 100k offered. The validators are still under-driven.

decision.reason: Pipeline depth 4 improves TPS from 34,521 to 51,118, proving external concurrency is the current bottleneck. But even depth 4 only drives ~47k measured RPS on one external host. The loadgen host is either CPU-bound or SSH-session-bound across 12 concurrent loadgen processes. The validators are still under-driven and would commit more if load actually arrived.
decision.next_move: Increase external loadgen capacity: raise PIPELINE_DEPTH further, increase writers per endpoint, split load across multiple external loadgen hosts, or run multiple loadgen processes per endpoint on the external host. The validator binary/config remains unchanged — this is purely a load-generation capacity problem now.
